title: Coral and the Debt
author: Theo Thornbury
blurb: Oscar Vasquez, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
